Exploration test FAILED on unfixed code as expected (bug confirmed). Three independent money sources do not reconcile:

(A) Deterministic — under-filled completed shift:
  AssertionError: expected 400000 to be 200000

  wallet released wages (walletStore ledger, WorkerWageReleased) = 200000 (only the filled position)
  worker totalIncome = Σ payoutAmount = 200000 (anchors to the wallet). Employer figure overstates by the unfilled position's deposit.

  AssertionError: expected 450000 to be 350000
  Two confirmed apps, payoutAmount 300000 + 150000. Ledger released WorkerPartialRelease 200000 + WorkerWageReleased 150000.
  worker totalIncome (Σ payoutAmount snapshots) = 450000
  walletStore.getBalance = 350000 (ledger truth). Dashboard trusts the stale payoutAmount.

(C) Property (fast-check) — Property failed after 1 test; seed -603971446, path "0:0"; shrunk 1 time.

  employer totalPaidOut = 40000 != wallet released wages = 20000.

Root cause confirmed: worker income sums application.payoutAmount (wage x hours, per position); employer paid sums shift.depositAmount (wage x hours x positionsTotal, all positions); wallet balance reads walletStore.getBalance — three independent sources, no single derived computation.
